_texte.Ce se întâmplă dacă refuz să confirm fin: What happens if I refuse to confirm completion?
_texte.Ești gata să plasezi prima ta comandă?: Ready to place your first order?
_texte.Metodele de plată acceptate pe My Darrin: The payment methods accepted on My Darrin and how the escrow system works.
_texte.Partenerul execută lucrarea: The partner carries out the work
_texte.Plătești către Home Best Pal SRL, antrep: You pay Home Best Pal SRL, the platform's general contractor. The amount is held as a guarantee until the work is confirmed.
_texte.Prin procesatorul de plăți al platformei: Through the platform's payment processor. Card details are entered at the processor.
_texte.Ordin de plată către Home Best Pal SRL,: A payment order to Home Best Pal SRL, based on the pro forma invoice you receive when you place the order.
_texte.Plasezi comanda și plătești: You place the order and pay
_texte.Primești factura proformă emisă de Home: You receive the pro forma invoice issued by Home Best Pal SRL and pay with one of the available methods.
_texte.Pe durata execuției, suma rămâne păstrat: While the work is carried out, the amount stays held as a guarantee. The partner does not receive it before the work is confirmed.
_texte.După ce partenerul raportează finalizare: Once the partner reports the work as finished, you confirm it or open a complaint.
_texte.După confirmare, suma se eliberează cătr: After confirmation, the amount is released to the partner.
_texte.Plata cu cardul se face prin procesatoru: Card payment is made through the platform's payment processor: card details are entered at the processor, not on My Darrin.
_texte.Dacă lucrarea nu este satisfăcătoare, de: If the work is not satisfactory, you open a complaint from the Complaints page. While the complaint is open, the amount is not released to the partner, and the My Darrin team reviews the complaint.
_texte.Momentan nu oferim plata în rate prin pl: We do not currently offer payment in instalments through the platform.
_texte.Da. La plasarea comenzii primești factur: Yes. When you place the order you receive the pro forma invoice issued by Home Best Pal SRL, and the tax invoice is also issued by Home Best Pal SRL, the general contractor.
_texte.În ce monedă plătesc?: Which currency do I pay in?
_texte.Prețurile se afișează și se plătesc în m: Prices are shown and paid in the currency of the country where the order is carried out.
